prompt.text:
Reference image 1 shows the chosen design of VAULT CLAW. Redraw the referenced subject as the sheet described below. Keep the exact design, silhouette, proportions, colour palette, materials, top-left lighting, outline weight and rendering style of the reference in every cell; only the pose or state changes from cell to cell, and the layout follows the grid described: Retro 16-bit video game sprite sheet for a horizontal arcade shooter, a regular grid of six equal cells in two rows of three with even gutters, read left to right and top to bottom, every cell showing the same VAULT CLAW enemy — a bone-white segmented hook of eight beaded links curling out of a socket bump of green tissue, the last link a sharp grabbing hook, side view facing left, at the same scale and position, on a perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key background. The frames in order: sheathed socket bump, first link emerging, half-extended four-link arc, fully extended eight-link hook, hooked shut on nothing, recoiling into the socket with fluid beads. Follow the established design exactly; only the pose or state changes between cells. Crisp pixel art with a 1-pixel near-black navy outline at the sprite's native pixel scale, flat saturated fills with three-step shading ramps lit from the top-left, identical silhouette and palette in every cell, no anti-aliasing, no scenery, no stars, no cast shadow, no glow bleeding onto the background, no text, no numbers, no cell borders. The background is one perfectly flat solid pure bright green chroma-key colour everywhere around the subject: no gradient, no texture, no floor, no cast or drop shadow, no glow or green spill on the subject. No text, letters, numbers, labels, UI or watermark anywhere.
 Cell one: only the brown tissue mound, no claw at all. Cell two: the mound with just the curved claw tip poking out of its hole. Cell three: the claw on a short neck of four beads, low and close to the mound. Cells four and five: the full tall arc of eight beads, claw open then clamped shut. Cell six: a short three-bead neck sinking back into the mound, fluid drops falling.
prompt.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, labels, numbers, cell borders, watermark, blurry, green tint on the subject, green spill
